status.initialize_description: Open the OpenBao web UI to initialize it. Store the root token and the keys it shows in a safe place: they are displayed only once and cannot be recovered.
status.initialize_description_auto: Open the OpenBao web UI to initialize it. Store the root token and the recovery keys it shows in a safe place: they are displayed only once and cannot be recovered.

status.not_running_description: Check the system logs of the application for errors.

settings.title: Settings
settings.host_helper: OpenBao API and web UI are published at this address
settings.unseal_mode_manual_description: OpenBao starts sealed after every restart, including updates and node reboots. An operator must enter the unseal keys. The keys never touch the server disk.
settings.unseal_mode_auto_description: A static key, generated and stored on the node and included in backups, unseals OpenBao at startup. Anyone with access to the node disk or to the backup can decrypt the stored secrets.
settings.unseal_mode_locked: The unseal mode cannot be changed after OpenBao is initialized
settings.unseal_mode_cannot_verify: Start OpenBao before changing the unseal mode
settings.restart_warning_description: Changing the host name or the unseal mode restarts OpenBao. With manual unseal it must be unsealed again afterwards.
settings.audit_log_helper: Record every OpenBao request in the system logs. Sensitive values are hashed.
